notes: INTMAP is purely combinational and has no clock or reset. Concurrent SVA (sva_hint 'property'/'cover') must sample on a testbench-supplied clock, or be written as deferred immediate assertions (assert final).
The block has no parameters (spec section 8); 'parameters' is intentionally empty.
Not converted to requirements: 7.4 per-source clearing, 7.5 and 11 firmware/HAS obligations, 9 functions provided elsewhere, 11 open item 1 (timing/area comes from first synthesis).

requirements.text: o_int_fast[0] is a wire from i_int_dma (line 0, mcause 16).
o_int_fast[1] is the OR reduction of all 8 bits of i_int_spi_device (line 1, mcause 17); each bit alone raises the line.
o_int_fast[2] is the OR reduction of both bits of i_int_spi_host (line 2, mcause 18); each bit alone raises the line.
o_int_fast[3] is a wire from i_int_i2c (line 3, mcause 19).
o_int_fast[4] is a wire from i_int_uart_0 (line 4, mcause 20).
o_int_fast[5] is a wire from i_int_uart_1 (line 5, mcause 21).
o_int_fast[6] is the OR reduction of both bits of i_int_timer_1 (line 6, mcause 22); each bit alone raises the line.
o_int_fast[7] is the OR reduction of all 4 bits of i_int_pwm (line 7, mcause 23); each bit alone raises the line.
o_int_fast[8] is a wire from i_int_wdt_wakeup (line 8, mcause 24).
o_int_fast[9] is the OR reduction of all 3 bits of i_int_gpio (line 9, mcause 25); each bit alone raises the line.
o_int_fast[10] is a wire from i_int_timer_0 (line 10, mcause 26).
o_int_nm is a wire from i_int_wdt_bark and depends on no other input; i_int_wdt_bark is never ORed and reaches no fast line.

One source group per line: no input affects any output other than its own line, and no line carries sources from two groups. The block performs no prioritisation or masking; asserting one group never suppresses another.
When inputs of several groups are asserted simultaneously, every affected line is asserted at the same time (cover the case of multiple and all groups active together).

Zero latency and no latching: every output follows its inputs combinationally with no cycle of delay. A held input keeps its line asserted for as long as it is held (including a clock-gated peripheral, 7.5); a pulse that ends deasserts the line in the same cycle.

The module has exactly these ports and no others: inputs i_int_dma[0:0], i_int_spi_device[7:0] (bits in vendor port declaration order), i_int_spi_host[1:0] (bit 0 error, bit 1 event), i_int_i2c, i_int_uart_0, i_int_uart_1, i_int_timer_1[1:0] (bit 0 irq_lo_o, bit 1 irq_hi_o), i_int_pwm[3:0] (bit n = events_o[n]), i_int_wdt_wakeup, i_int_gpio[2:0] (bit n = GPIOn), i_int_timer_0, i_int_wdt_bark; outputs o_int_fast[10:0], o_int_nm. Total 26 input bits and 12 output bits. No i_clk_*, i_rst_n_* or bus port. Names follow QNSC_RTL_Design_Naming_Rule V1.0 section 3.6.

Integration note for design/top (not implemented or tagged in m_qnsc_intmap, no SVA): o_int_fast drives Ibex irq_fast_i[10:0]; o_int_nm drives irq_nm_i; irq_fast_i[14:11] is tied 4'b0; irq_external_i, irq_timer_i and irq_software_i are tied 0.
review_log: Ask 1/3 (score 0.35): top-level tie-offs are outside m_qnsc_intmap. User chose (b): keep as integration note only, no SVA, no RTL tag. Resolved at 0.10.

requirements.text: Combinational-only implementation: the synthesisable body consists solely of continuous assign statements; no always_ff, no always_latch, no flip-flop, no latch, no module instance. The only other construct allowed is the simulation-only always_comb assertion block of REQ-021 inside `ifndef SYNTHESIS.
Module name m_qnsc_intmap in block directory design/intmap; the module has no parameters and is instantiated exactly once, in design/top.

Line order is the priority order and is fixed per the table in 7.2: line n has mcause 16+n and vector mtvec + 4*mcause (NMI: mcause 31, mtvec + 0x7C). Line indices in RTL come from qnsc_pkg constants C_INT_LINE_* (rtl_rule.md section 2), not literal numbers; their values must equal the table in 7.2.
review_log: Spec 7.1 snippet uses literal indices; rtl_rule.md section 2 forbids typed shared numbers. Repository rule wins; resolved at 0.20 without asking.
